name: Alcaldía de Soacha
body: A meta description on every page read, framing limited to its origin, nosniff, and port 80 closed. But no Strict-Transport-Security header is sent, so browsers are never told to insist on https.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of a year or more: one header.
summary: www.alcaldiasoacha.gov.co scores 78 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 26 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /Paginas/Inicio.aspx, /Paginas/Alcalde.aspx, /Transparencia/Paginas/Transparencia-y-Acceso-a-la-Informacion-Publica.aspx, /AtencionalCiudadano/Paginas/Politica-y-Proteccion-de-Datos.aspx and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 81 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.
